releaseNotes:
CantosTV v1.5.3

- Movies and Series load more reliably now, with a clear message and a Retry
  button if the provider is unavailable (note: some providers block movies and
  series while you're on a VPN - turn the VPN off if they won't load).
- Multiscreen: pick channels from a Continue Watching folder, and every channel
  you open in a pane is added to Continue Watching.
- Fixed the Back button closing the whole channel list instead of stepping back.
- Movies/Series: seeking recovers on its own if it ever gets stuck (no more
  closing and reopening), and the progress bar stays in sync after you skip.
- New updates now prompt you right away while you're using the app.
